basic_info.description: Elegant turn-key Victorian residence in one of the hottest neighborhoods in the City! Tall ceilings invite cheerful sunlight into the open living area with dual-pane Bay windows and a tranquil skylight, highlighting the newly refinished wood flooring. Serene main bedroom has a wardrobe armoire with rod and shelves, plus a closet. Efficiently designed kitchen features quartz countertops, ample storage cabinets, a suite of stainless steel appliances, and stylish tile flooring. Nestled in the back of the flat is a delightful office space/ bonus room offering peek-a-boo views of the city skyline and serving as a peaceful escape from the bustle of urban life. Full bath with shower over deep tub combo. Stacked in-unit laundry in hallway. 98 walk score. Steps to groceries or boutique shopping, Blue Bottle or La Boulangerie, world class dining [Rich Table/ Absinthe], nearby parks like Patricia's Green & Alamo Square, tech-shuttles, Muni or BART, SF Jazz Center, Opera/ Ballet, Symphony and Civic Center. Thoughtfully updated, well maintained pay-as-you-go building, this unit has two large secure storage spaces with ground floor access, room for bicycles/ wine, sports equipment or studio-workshop. Welcome home to your City residence! See HayesValleyVictorian.com to schedule a showing.
